name: Missing Value Audit
summary: Calculate the missing value rate per column and overall
purpose: Calculate the missing value rate per column and overall. Flag columns or datasets with excessive missing data.
assignment_instructions: You are auditing missing values in a dataset. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_missing_value_audit_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - overall_missing_rate (number between 0 and 1): total missing cells / total cells - column_missing_rates (list of objects): column_name (string), missing_count (integer), total_rows (integer), missing_rate (number) - columns_above_threshold (list of strings): column names with missing_rate > 0.10 - total_rows (integer) - total_columns (integer) Compute overall_missing_rate as total_null_cells / (total_rows * total_columns). Compute each column's missing_rate as null_count_in_column / total_rows. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include formulas in calculations array. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: Number of column rates must equal total_columns
Every column in columns_above_threshold must have rate > 0.10
deterministic_checks.assertion: all(col.missing_rate > 0.10 for col in result.column_missing_rates if col.column_name in result.columns_above_threshold)

math_checks.description: Overall rate of missing values across entire dataset

evidence_checks.description: Each entry must have column_name, missing_count, total_rows, missing_rate

flag_rules.description: One or more columns have missing rate exceeding 10%
